# RadioReach

> Radio promotion resources for independent musicians and artists.

RadioReach provides downloadable resources intended to help independent
artists research and contact radio stations.

## Main page

- https://radioreach.us/

## Primary resource

- Radio Reach Vault
- Radio station contact resource for independent musicians
- 18,000+ unique radio contact emails in a filterable spreadsheet plus a
  600+ page searchable PDF directory
- Find stations by city, state, country, station, format, and genre
- Contact roles include music directors, DJs, programmers, station staff,
  and submission routes
- Covers college radio, community stations, FM/AM, internet radio,
  independent outlets, and international markets
- Includes 200 selected priority music-submission and artist-outreach routes

## Canonical domain

https://radioreach.us/
